grammar.composition_primitive: Minimal centered wordmark/navigation above a full-width cinematic landscape frame; after the media, a narrow title/offer block and vertically ordered destination cards.
grammar.visual_hierarchy: Small restrained navigation; destination title is large and centered; offer descriptions are modest and short.
grammar.typography_observation: Small restrained navigation; destination title is large and centered; offer descriptions are modest and short.
grammar.media_observation: Large mountain landscape frame with visible playback controls in the captured still; subsequent destination cards use contained photography. Playback itself was not runtime-tested.
grammar.spatial_rhythm: Large immersive media opening, then small quiet intro, then repeated destination modules separated by generous vertical space.
grammar.responsive_recomposition: Media becomes a narrow vertical viewport crop; destination modules reflow to one column and retain generous spacing; header utility controls stay compact.
grammar.implementation_boundary: DOM: title, copy, navigation and destination cards. Asset: video only if source and rights verified; provide poster/fallback image. Background: neutral warm canvas. Cards use separately cropped image assets.
misuse_constraints: Requires distinctive place footage or photography and rights clearance.
Do not infer motion quality from player controls in a still image.
Keep a non-video fallback and avoid autoplay sound.
Short offer copy; destination labels must remain visible on narrow crop.

grammar.composition_primitive: Compact institutional header and primary blue navigation; below it, an asymmetric multi-column first layer with a large announcement/hero panel, search/task controls, news list, and supporting modules.
grammar.visual_hierarchy: Small high-density navigation; task labels and news headlines use restrained hierarchy; blue bar separates primary navigation from content.
grammar.typography_observation: Small high-density navigation; task labels and news headlines use restrained hierarchy; blue bar separates primary navigation from content.
grammar.media_observation: Official announcement image in one bounded feature panel; secondary modules rely mostly on text and small visual tiles.
grammar.spatial_rhythm: Dense, highly grouped utility modules; repeated horizontal rules/colored containers separate functions.
grammar.responsive_recomposition: Primary nav compresses to compact top controls; multi-column groups stack vertically; search/task block moves near top; informational items retain boxed grouping.
grammar.implementation_boundary: DOM: nav landmarks, search/links, announcement, lists, headings. CSS Grid for desktop; one-column DOM order matching task priority on mobile. Image assets remain decorative only where text duplicates content.
misuse_constraints: Task priority must be supported by user research/official service obligations; do not copy source order blindly.
Dense layouts require responsive spacing, visible focus and legible line lengths.
Accessibility runtime was not tested; this record makes no accessibility pass claim.
